issues.on_page: Grants 887,662 (General 185,295; Street 170,923; Debt Service 15,347; Other Governmental 516,097)
issues.issue: Mixed grantors. The General Fund's 185,295 is Federal Receipts on p8 and State and Federal Grants on p10; Street and Debt Service are State Receipts Other (p8); the Economic Development 516,097 grantor is not printed. The category is defensible and has a review note.
Grantor not printed. It could be federal (e.g. CDBG) as well as state.

issues.on_page: Debt Service Fund 'Other Financing Uses' 2,374,878 under Charges to appropriations (budget 2,087,771)
issues.issue: Recorded as other financing because of the printed label. On the GAAP statement (p4) this money is the Debt Service Fund's bond and lease payments (2,382,100), not a transfer, so the Debt Service Fund has no expenditure lines in detail. budget_final is positive (2,087,771) while the amount is negative. Street's printed Other Financing Uses budget '-' is null.

issues.on_page: Cash and Cash Equivalents 14,486,046; Cash with Fiscal Agent 162,560; Equity in Pooled Cash and Investments 2,955,719 (Total Governmental Funds)
issues.issue: ending_cash takes only the Cash and Cash Equivalents line. The pooled cash and investments line and the fiscal agent cash are printed but are in neither ending_cash nor ending_investments. This matches the FY2024 convention (FY2024 ending_cash 14,630,606, p3).

issues.extracted: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) only
issues.on_page: Governmental funds Balance Sheet (p3) and Proprietary Statement of Net Position (p5)
issues.issue: Two more balance-sheet pages in the trim are not recorded as balance_sheet lines. This follows the GAAP rule (government-wide Statement of Net Position), and the p5 proprietary totals agree with the business-type column on p1 (55,322,676 / 6,339,827 / 48,982,849). It is noted so the user knows they were read and not entered.

This could be grants/payments to other entities (likely a payment to the economic development corporation; p8 budgets Economic Development 650,000 separately). Likewise Emergency Services 485,489 (detail[54]) and Recreation Coordination 114,000 (detail[56]). The function category general government matches the statement (p4).

issues.on_page: Capital Contributions (289,283) under Other Financing Sources (Uses); Statement of Activities p2 prints it as 'Transfers of Capital'
issues.issue: The capital contribution to the enterprise funds is recorded as other financing on both sides (governmental -289,283; business_type.other_financing +289,283), not as transfers. This is consistent and matches the printed section, but the Statement of Activities calls it a transfer.
